Oak Creek Power Station, Western Lake Michigan south of Milwaukee

2011-11-02
On Oct 31, 2011 a landslide of about 25,000 cubic yards of fly ash along the western shore of Lake Michigan resulted an unknown quality of fly ash entering Lake Michigan.
